results.title: Wicked: For Good Sing-Along
results.description:
Watch Wicked: For Good on the Library's big screen and sing along to the songs. All ages and abilities are welcome. 

Defy gravity with us at a spellbinding sing-along at the Library! Whether you're a longtime fan or just discovering the magic of Oz, this is your chance to belt out your favorite songs.

Wicked: For Good

PG, 2025, 138 minutes

Synopsis: Elphaba and Glinda are now estranged, each living with the consequences of their choices. Elphaba, now demonized as The Wicked Witch of the West, lives in exile, continuing her fight to expose The Wizard. Meanwhile, Glinda has become a glamorous symbol of Goodness, basking in the perks of fame and popularity. As the angry citizens of Oz rise up against the Wicked Witch, Glinda and Elphaba must reunite and truly see each other.

results.title: Book Club to Go
results.description:
Stop in to check out Book Club to Go: no meetings or deadlines, just great books.

Each title comes with a discussion guide with questions to think about while reading, author information, and librarian recommendations. Read the book at your leisure and return when you're finished!

Our October selection is The Hacienda by Isabel Canas. Copies will be available at the reference desk starting on the first Monday of the month.

Want a digital copy? Search for the eBook or audiobook on Libby.

The Hacienda by Isabel Canas

In the overthrow of the Mexican government, Beatriz's father is executed and her home destroyed. When handsome Don Rodolfo Solórzano proposes, Beatriz ignores the rumors surrounding his first wife's sudden demise, choosing instead to seize the security his estate in the countryside provides. She will have her own home again, no matter the cost. But Hacienda San Isidro is not the sanctuary she imagined. When Rodolfo returns to work in the capital, visions and voices invade Beatriz's sleep. The weight of invisible eyes follows her every move. Rodolfo's sister, Juana, scoffs at Beatriz's fears--but why does she refuse to enter the house at night? Why does the cook burn copal incense at the edge of the kitchen and mark its doorway with strange symbols? What really happened to the first Doña Solórzano? Beatriz only knows two things for certain. Something is wrong with the hacienda. And no one there will help her.

results.title: CANCELED- Author Visit: Delsie Moore
results.description:
This program is canceled due to unforeseen circumstances. 

Meet with local author, Delsie Moore, as she highlights her book about death and grief, Her Wings Were Ready, My Heart Was Not. 

Visit with Delsie on the Main Floor of the Library. She also writes Fantasy & Romantic Fiction books. 

Delsie Moore was born in Charleston, West Virginia, and raised in Houston, Texas, where her love for storytelling and imagination first took root. A devoted mother and proud grandmother, she finds her greatest joy in spending time with her growing family, especially her amazing grandchildren, who continue to inspire her sense of wonder and creativity.

Delsie Now resides in Ohio, where she has embraced a new chapter of her life and with it, her long-awaited dream of becoming an author. THE BAD WITCH marks her official debut, a project fueled by the passion, heart, and the desire to create something memorable for readers of all ages.

Her writing blends the spirit of her roots, the wisdom of her experiences, and the spark of playfulness she's never let go of. The Bad Witch is only the beginning of a journey she's excited to share with the world.

results.title: CANCELLED- Job & Family Services
results.description:
Meet one-on-one with a case manager from the Summit County Job & Family Services.

Due to funding and administrative needs, Job and Family Services is temporarily suspending all outreach services beginning September 1.

This program is a partnership with Summit County Department of Job & Family Services. To learn more about the Department of Job & Family Services, click this link. The case manager will be at the Library from 10 AM - 4 PM on the first Tuesday of the month. 

Case managers can assist with:

  • Applying for or renewing cash, food, or medical assistance.
  • Answering case or eligibility questions.
  • Scanning documents and verifications.
  • Making copies of important documents, such as birth certificates, Social Security cards, pay stubs, etc. 
  • Accessing benefit issuance history.
  • Getting additional resources and support services.

results.title: Friends of the Library Meeting
results.description:
The Friends of the Barberton Public Library is a 501(c) 3 volunteer organization that exists to help enrich the programs, services, and materials provided to the community by the Library.  Through Friends support, additional programs and services that cannot be included in the Library's tax-supported budget are made possible. The Friends of the Library has two main sources of funding: the generous support of members who pay yearly dues and the revenues generated by book sales. 

Regular bi-monthly meetings are on the third Wednesday of every other month in January, March, May, July, September, and November at 6:00 p.m. in the Spillette Meeting Room.

All are welcome to attend!

This free legal clinic will provide members of the community with a “One-Stop Shop” legal aid service and court access. It is ready to help resolve family matters and offers legal help with divorce, separation, civil protection orders, or child custody.  

Register at https://drcourt.org/wp/ojb-registration/. Walk-ins are also welcome.
